name: polyglav-core-repl
description: Terminal REPL front-end - bundled with polyglav

clear_screen.description: Clear the screen and reprint the header on startup

confirm_timeout.description: Seconds a confirm or ask prompt waits before auto-denying

glyphs.description: Glyph overrides, or "ascii" for the ASCII preset

hide_confirm_input.description: Hide typed input for the tool confirm prompt

output_log.description: Write everything the REPL prints to a file

output_log_ansi.description: Keep ANSI colors in the output log

show_version.description: Show the version in the startup header

verbosity.description: Display volume: quiet, normal, or verbose

verbosity.footer.description: Footer detail: off, summary, full, or inherit

verbosity.output.description: Sub-run output scope: off, assistant, agent, all, or inherit

verbosity.status.description: Live status time and approximate tokens: off, on, or inherit

verbosity.thinking.description: Reasoning scope: off, assistant, agent, all, or inherit

verbosity.tools.description: Tool detail: off, summary, full, or inherit
